title: Accessibility Audit page result (one line of pages.jsonl)
description: One page: its template, its states, and the result of each criterion at each width. The states roll up into the page result. The results for each state are in runs/, not in Git. See PLAN.md sections 7.2 and 8.1.

set.description: The set of web pages, for the site tests.

sample.description: True when the page is in the sample for the template tests.

process.description: The process that this page is a step of, or null.

run.description: The run that gave these results.

not_tested_reason.description: Why the page was not tested. The last five name an address that is not a page of the site: it does not count in the pages found or in the coverage. stopped: the audit was stopped before this page.

redirects_to.description: The address after the redirects, for an address that was not tested there: another site, a skipped path, an error page, or a file.

linked_from.description: For a broken link: the pages that link to it, up to 5.

results.description: Keyed by the width in CSS px, then by the criterion ID.

issues.description: The issues that have an occurrence on this page.
